title: La Golondrina
attribution: Written in 1862 by the Mexican physician and composer Narciso Serradell Sevilla (1843-1910); the Spanish words are attributed to Niceto de Zamacois (died 1885), after an older poem. Both died well over 100 years ago, so melody and words are public domain. Melody checked against the voice part of the free 8notes score and MIDI (transposed from E flat to C); the F sharps are chromatic neighbour notes expected to show as out-of-key. Notes written (0.333333333) are triplet eighths.
